output.content:
AWS generated **$35.579 billion of net sales (segment revenue)** in Amazon’s fourth quarter ended December 31, 2025, up **24% year over year** from $28.786 billion. [[1, 2]] 

AWS segment operating income was **$12.5 billion**, versus **$10.6 billion** in Q4 2024. [[2]]
